Dr Michaels has referred me on several occasions for completely incorrect conditions, and I have had to submit a formal complaint due to his unprofessional manner.

The practice also does not seem to read referrals or the information patients provide. On two consecutive days I was asked to complete another triage form because the previous one clearly hadn’t been read. It’s incredibly frustrating and shows a lack of care and attention to patients.

I have been registered here for 35 years and am now looking to move because the service has become so poor.

In contrast, during the last year I was treated by Dr Fardowsa, who was amazing and by far the best GP I have ever had. She helped me and my family so much. Unfortunately, since she left, the experience at this surgery has been awful. I would not recommend registering
